grounding_contract: Document-dependent tasks require observed source provenance; self-contained/reference tasks may derive from user facts. Generic core also exposes this through --source-required, with abstention allowed; no fixed tool sequence or minimum action count.
source_policy: No data cleaning, rewriting, filtering, or repartitioning; reuse existing exact context and v2 tree/entity indexes
exposure: Both datasets and prior v3 conditions are known. General output failure recovery was changed after actual truncation errors; no per-case rules or gold in prompts. Post-hoc development, not unseen-test confirmation.
selection: all19 math and all125 Multi-Document QA; report every outcome, no question-level routing or favorable subset selection
reference_policy: Global optional answer-review ablation fixed before v2/v3 scores were inspected. All19/all125. Review disabled everywhere; no per-question routing. Exact completed v3-v3 request caches may be reused, explicitly reported. No generation/grade row copying.
